dedupe_keys.name: leakg3pd od demand based water network leakage dataset

description: LeakG3PD-OD is a simulated water-distribution benchmark for detecting and locating leaks primarily from automated-meter-reading demand signals. Matheus Pilotto and collaborators derive it from the 500 Net3 scenarios in LeakG3PD. They introduce missing values, fraudulent readings and measurement errors into demands, then replace tanks with reservoirs and pumps with low-roughness pipes that retain pump controls. Imposed reservoir head patterns reproduce reference pressures before the altered model generates estimated pressures and link flows. Leak positions are recorded as distances along pipes. Coverage is the synthetic EPANET Net3 benchmark, without a geographic survey or stated common sampling interval in the inspected README. The public Drive folder lists a roughly 9.95 GB ZIP archive; it was not downloaded. Access is free, with EUPL 1.2 for the GitHub generator and no separately stated archive licence. Regeneration is stochastic and does not reproduce the exact published values. Simulation uses include testing sensitivity to demand-measurement errors and hydraulic-model mismatch. It relates to model-wntr and data-leakdb. The separate G8 LeakG3PD draft covers the parent collection, not this transformed release.
